frame: Cupix project coordinates, E57 Z-up converted to Y-up [x,z,-y]. No added floor elevation.
projection: E57 sphericalRepresentation; image center +X, camera +Z up
privacy: Automatic face/person blur and a fixed nadir cone applied before packaging, then a manual contact-sheet review of all 100 blurred panoramas; publishing approved by the owner on 2026-10-28. Detection can miss people: not a claim of full anonymisation. sha256 = published blurred file; originalSha256 = E57 image.
navigation: Consecutive exported frames from one source video; distance <=5.5m and height difference <=1.5m. Sparse gaps are not linked. Interpolation is a visual blend, not measured parallax.
